note: Five albedo classes by effective temperature: I ammonia clouds at about 150 K or below; II water clouds; III clear, with sodium and potassium absorption; IV 900 to 1500 K, alkali absorption above a deep silicate layer; V above about 1500 K or at low gravity, high silicate cloud; Abstract supports the class list as cited. Class V has low gravity as an alternative trigger, and classes II and III carry no temperature bounds in the abstract. The thresholds on 1-bar temperature are your adaptation, as your line says.
